title: Computer Architecture Laboratory
objectives:
The purpose of this laboratory is to acquaint students with the concepts presented in the computer
architecture course such as designing digital circuits, how to analyze and debugging them,
designing logic and arithmetic parts of a processor, designing memory units, input/output, data
path, and control unit in a typical processor, Using hardware description languages such as Verilog
and VHDL to describe their structure, synthesize and finally implement on FPGA boards.
textbooks:
1. S. Brown, Z. Vranesic, Fundamentals of Digital Logic with Verilog Design, McGraw-Hill,
2003.
2. B. Parhami, Computer Arithmetic, Algorithms and Hardware Designs, Oxford University Press,
2000.
